name: Oriental
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Oriental?
answer_short: Yes. Oriental allows a licensed driver to operate a golf cart on public streets. State law lets the town do that on streets posted 35 mph or less. The cart needs a mirror and brake lights, and lights if you drive after dark.

golf_cart.roads: Public streets posted 35 mph or less

rules.rule: A licensed driver may operate a golf cart on public streets in town. After dark the cart needs headlights, turn signals and brake lights.
A city may allow golf carts on streets posted 35 mph or less
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Oriental?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on NC 55 in Oriental?
faq.a: Only where it is posted 35 mph or less. Faster stretches stay closed.
